text: Plantix - About the company Plantix is an acquired company based in Berlin (Germany), founded in 2015 by Rahul Singh Solanki, Simone Strey, Alexander Forster and Robert Strey. It operates as a Developer of mobile software for identifying plant diseases and pests. Plantix has raised $7.31M in funding from RTP Global. The company has 157 active competitors, including 5 funded and 4 that have exited. Its top competitors include companies like Enko, Eco Ation and Prospera. Company Details Developer of mobile software for identifying plant diseases and pests. This application utilizes image recognition technology to analyze photographs of crops, providing diagnostic results and treatment recommendations. The software assists in managing agricultural health by offering information on disease prevention and cultivation methods.
